enonce_complet: ## Quickstart {% id="quickstart" %} Requires SDK 3.2 or later (`pip install -U google-genai` or `npm install @google/genai@latest`). Pass a model, shared input, and a map of questions. Each question requires a type ([`noul`](/docs/decisions-api#noul) for yes/no) and instructions: {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input="The blue mug I ordered on Monday arrived cracked on Wednesday.", questions={ "is_damaged": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Did the item arrive damaged?", }, }, ) answer = result.answers["is_damaged"] print(f"P(yes)={answer.noul:.2f} confidence={answer.confidence:.2f}") ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: "The blue mug I ordered on Monday arrived cracked on Wednesday.", questions: { is_damaged: { type: "noul", instructions: "Did the item arrive damaged?", }, }, }); const answer = result.answers?.is_damaged; if (answer?.type === "noul") { console.log(`P(yes)=${answer.noul} confidence=${answer.confidence}`); } ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": "The blue mug I ordered on Monday arrived cracked on Wednesday.", "questions": { "is_damaged": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Did the item arrive damaged?" } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} The API returns calibrated probabilities and token usage: ```json { "answers": { "is_damaged": { "type": "noul", "noul": 0.99, "confidence": 0.99 } }, "usage": { "total_input_tokens": 100, "input_tokens_by_modality": [{ "modality": "text", "tokens": 100 }], "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 100 } } ```

## Question types {% id="question-types" %} ### Yes or no (noul) {% id="noul" %} A yes/no question returns the calibrated probability that the answer is yes. Add criteria to define what yes and no mean when the question alone is ambiguous. {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input="Customer returned the sweater because they preferred green over blue.", questions={ "is_defect": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Is the customer reporting a product defect?", "criteria": { "true_description": "The product itself is broken or faulty.", "false_description": "Preference, sizing, shipping, or pricing complaint.", }, }, }, ) print(result.answers["is_defect"].noul) ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: "Customer returned the sweater because they preferred green over blue.", questions: { is_defect: { type: "noul", instructions: "Is the customer reporting a product defect?", criteria: { true_description: "The product itself is broken or faulty.", false_description: "Preference, sizing, shipping, or pricing complaint.", }, }, }, }); const answer = result.answers?.is_defect; if (answer?.type === "noul") console.log(answer.noul); ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": "Customer returned the sweater because they preferred green over blue.", "questions": { "is_defect": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Is the customer reporting a product defect?", "criteria": { "true_description": "The product itself is broken or faulty.", "false_description": "Preference, sizing, shipping, or pricing complaint." } } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} Answer: ```json { "type": "noul", "noul": 0.03, "confidence": 0.97 } ``` {% callout type="note" %} Yes/no probabilities always fall between 0.01 and 0.99. Set thresholds inside that range, since a check above 0.99 never matches. {% /callout %} ### Pick one option (choice) {% id="choice" %} A choice question scores a fixed set of options and returns both the top option and the calibrated probability of every option (summing to 1). Criteria maps each option ID to a description of when it applies. Use an empty string (`""`) when the option ID is self-explanatory. Before evaluation, the API sorts option keys alphabetically in UTF-8 byte order. Changing key order in your JSON request doesn't change option positions, and exact probability ties break to the alphabetically first key. {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input="I was charged twice for my order.", questions={ "department": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "Which department should handle this request?", "criteria": { "billing": "Payments, invoices, and refunds.", "technical": "Problems using the product.", "shipping": "Delivery and tracking.", "other": "Anything outside these categories.", }, }, }, ) answer = result.answers["department"] print(answer.choice, answer.confidence, answer.probabilities) ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: "I was charged twice for my order.", questions: { department: { type: "choice", instructions: "Which department should handle this request?", criteria: { billing: "Payments, invoices, and refunds.", technical: "Problems using the product.", shipping: "Delivery and tracking.", other: "Anything outside these categories.", }, }, }, }); const answer = result.answers?.department; if (answer?.type === "choice") { console.log(answer.choice, answer.confidence, answer.probabilities); } ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": "I was charged twice for my order.", "questions": { "department": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "Which department should handle this request?", "criteria": { "billing": "Payments, invoices, and refunds.", "technical": "Problems using the product.", "shipping": "Delivery and tracking.", "other": "Anything outside these categories." } } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} Answer: ```json { "type": "choice", "choice": "billing", "probabilities": { "billing": 0.99, "shipping": 0.004, "other": 0.003, "technical": 0.002 }, "confidence": 0.99 } ``` {% callout type="note" %} Choice questions always distribute probability across your options, even when none fits. Threshold confidence to catch low-certainty inputs, pair the question with a separate yes/no scope check, or add a catch-all option such as "other" with an explicit description. Avoid positional keys like "none_of_the_above": alphabetical sorting places it ahead of keys like "shipping" and "technical" instead of last. {% /callout %} ### Rate on a scale (score) {% id="score" %} A score question rates the input across ordered levels. Criteria is an array of non-empty level descriptions ordered from lowest to highest (2 to 255 levels, with 2 to 10 recommended for most rubrics), indexed starting at 0. The returned score is the probability-weighted average of the level indices, so it can fall between levels, and legend maps each index back to its description. {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input="Export fails in Safari but works in Chrome.", questions={ "severity": { "type": "score", "instructions": "How severe is this issue for the user?", "criteria": [ "Cosmetic: appearance only, no lost functionality.", "Workaround available: a task fails, but another way works.", "Fully blocked: a task fails with no workaround.", ], }, }, ) answer = result.answers["severity"] print(answer.score, answer.confidence, answer.probabilities) ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: "Export fails in Safari but works in Chrome.", questions: { severity: { type: "score", instructions: "How severe is this issue for the user?", criteria: [ "Cosmetic: appearance only, no lost functionality.", "Workaround available: a task fails, but another way works.", "Fully blocked: a task fails with no workaround.", ], }, }, }); const answer = result.answers?.severity; if (answer?.type === "score") { console.log(answer.score, answer.confidence, answer.probabilities); } ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": "Export fails in Safari but works in Chrome.", "questions": { "severity": { "type": "score", "instructions": "How severe is this issue for the user?", "criteria": [ "Cosmetic: appearance only, no lost functionality.", "Workaround available: a task fails, but another way works.", "Fully blocked: a task fails with no workaround." ] } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} Answer: ```json { "type": "score", "score": 1.12, "legend": { "0": "Cosmetic: appearance only, no lost functionality.", "1": "Workaround available: a task fails, but another way works.", "2": "Fully blocked: a task fails with no workaround." }, "probabilities": { "0": 0.03, "1": 0.83, "2": 0.15 }, "confidence": 0.83 } ``` Because different probability distributions can produce the same expected value (here 1.12, sitting just above level 1), check the per-level probabilities and confidence alongside the score when inputs can split across levels. Use the score to rank inputs or filter candidate results against a rubric threshold. When your code needs a discrete level, pick the entry with the highest probability: ```python level = max(answer.probabilities, key=answer.probabilities.get) # "1" print(answer.legend[level]) # "Workaround available: ..." ``` To compare scales with different numbers of levels, divide the score by the highest level index to normalize it between 0 and 1.

## Ask multiple questions {% id="multiple-questions" %} Put independent questions about the same input in one request. Shared input counts once per request regardless of how many questions you ask (each question adds only its own instructions and criteria), and question types can be mixed. This example routes a support ticket using order data and the customer message. {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python import json from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) order = {"order": {"id": "8821", "item": "headphones", "price_usd": 240}, "tier": "Gold"} message = {"message": "Audio cuts out on the left earcup. Fix it today or I cancel my membership."} result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input=[ {"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(order) + "
"}, {"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(message)}, ], questions={ "is_defect": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Does `message` describe a hardware defect?", }, "next_action": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "What is the right resolution given `tier` and `order`?", "criteria": { "instant_refund": "Refund without return. Low value or clear fault.", "replacement_shipment": "Ship a replacement. Customer returns the original.", "troubleshooting_flow": "The issue may be fixable by the customer.", "human_escalation": "", }, }, "churn_risk": { "type": "score", "instructions": "How likely is the customer to churn if the issue is not resolved now?", "criteria": [ "No churn signal", "Mild frustration", "Mentions alternatives", "Threatens to cancel", ], }, }, ) a = result.answers if a["is_defect"].noul > 0.9 and a["next_action"].confidence > 0.6: action = a["next_action"].choice else: action = "human_escalation" print(action, a["churn_risk"].score) ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const order = { order: { id: "8821", item: "headphones", price_usd: 240 }, tier: "Gold" }; const message = { message: "Audio cuts out on the left earcup. Fix it today or I cancel my membership." }; const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: [ { type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(order) + "
" }, { type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(message) }, ], questions: { is_defect: { type: "noul", instructions: "Does `message` describe a hardware defect?", }, next_action: { type: "choice", instructions: "What is the right resolution given `tier` and `order`?", criteria: { instant_refund: "Refund without return. Low value or clear fault.", replacement_shipment: "Ship a replacement. Customer returns the original.", troubleshooting_flow: "The issue may be fixable by the customer.", human_escalation: "", }, }, churn_risk: { type: "score", instructions: "How likely is the customer to churn if the issue is not resolved now?", criteria: ["No churn signal", "Mild frustration", "Mentions alternatives", "Threatens to cancel"], }, }, }); const { is_defect, next_action, churn_risk } = result.answers ?? {}; let action = "human_escalation"; if ( is_defect?.type === "noul" && next_action?.type === "choice" && (is_defect.noul ?? 0) > 0.9 && (next_action.confidence ?? 0) > 0.6 ) { action = next_action.choice ?? action; } console.log(action, churn_risk?.type === "score" ? churn_risk.score : undefined); ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": [ { "type": "text", "text": "{"order": {"id": "8821", "item": "headphones", "price_usd": 240}, "tier": "Gold"}
" }, { "type": "text", "text": "{"message": "Audio cuts out on the left earcup. Fix it today or I cancel my membership."}" } ], "questions": { "is_defect": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Does `message` describe a hardware defect?" }, "next_action": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "What is the right resolution given `tier` and `order`?", "criteria": { "instant_refund": "Refund without return. Low value or clear fault.", "replacement_shipment": "Ship a replacement. Customer returns the original.", "troubleshooting_flow": "The issue may be fixable by the customer.", "human_escalation": "" } }, "churn_risk": { "type": "score", "instructions": "How likely is the customer to churn if the issue is not resolved now?", "criteria": ["No churn signal", "Mild frustration", "Mentions alternatives", "Threatens to cancel"] } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} Response: ```json { "answers": { "is_defect": { "type": "noul", "noul": 0.94, "confidence": 0.94 }, "next_action": { "type": "choice", "choice": "human_escalation", "probabilities": { "human_escalation": 0.76, "replacement_shipment": 0.18, "troubleshooting_flow": 0.04, "instant_refund": 0.02 }, "confidence": 0.76 }, "churn_risk": { "type": "score", "score": 2.99, "legend": { "0": "No churn signal", "1": "Mild frustration", "2": "Mentions alternatives", "3": "Threatens to cancel" }, "probabilities": { "0": 0.0, "1": 0.0, "2": 0.01, "3": 0.99 }, "confidence": 0.99 } }, "usage": { "total_input_tokens": 324, "input_tokens_by_modality": [{ "modality": "text", "tokens": 324 }], "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 324 } } ``` Some decisions depend on another, for example picking a repair category only if the item is damaged. Either send a second request after you read the first answer, or ask both questions in one request and ignore the answer you don't need.

titre: google-decisions-guide-v1 — Answers, probabilities, and confidence {% id="confidence" %}
enonce_complet: ## Answers, probabilities, and confidence {% id="confidence" %} Each answer includes calibrated probabilities and a confidence score: * **Top value:** Probability of yes for binary questions, most likely option for choice questions, or probability-weighted expected level for score questions. * **Probabilities:** On choice and score answers, a map of calibrated probabilities across all options or levels (summing to 1). For yes/no answers, the probability of no is 1 minus the yes probability. * **Confidence:** Estimated probability (from 0 to 1) that the top answer is right. Equals the top outcome's probability, or `max(noul, 1 - noul)` for yes/no questions. Use the answer value to pick an action and confidence to decide whether to run it automatically: ```python answer = result.answers["department"] if answer.confidence >= 0.7: route_to(answer.choice) else: route_to("human_review") ``` {% callout type="note" %} Set thresholds using labeled examples from your own traffic. Weigh the cost of a false positive against a false negative. {% /callout %}

## Input {% id="input" %} The input field accepts text, image, audio, video, and PDF document blocks using the same content block schema as the [Interactions API](/docs/interactions-overview) (tool-call, tool-result, and thought blocks aren't supported): ```none Input = string | Content | Content[] Content = TextContent | ImageContent | AudioContent | VideoContent | DocumentContent ``` | Block | Fields | Supported MIME types | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `text` | `text` | n/a | | `image` | `data` or `uri`, `mime_type`, optional `resolution` | `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/webp`, `image/heic`, `image/heif`, `image/gif`, `image/bmp`, `image/tiff` | | `audio` | `data` or `uri`, `mime_type` | `audio/wav`, `audio/mp3`, `audio/mpeg`, `audio/aiff`, `audio/aac`, `audio/ogg`, `audio/flac`, `audio/m4a`, `audio/opus`, `audio/webm`, `audio/l16`, `audio/alaw`, `audio/mulaw` | | `video` | `data` or `uri`, `mime_type`, optional `resolution` | `video/mp4`, `video/mpeg`, `video/mov`, `video/avi`, `video/webm`, `video/wmv`, `video/x-flv`, `video/3gpp` | | `document` | `data` or `uri`, `mime_type` | `application/pdf` | * Inline data accepts base64-encoded bytes (up to 100 MB per request, or 50 MB for PDFs). * URI inputs accept [Files API](/docs/files) URIs (`file.uri`) and public or signed HTTPS URLs (up to 15 MB per external URL). * Always set the MIME type to the real file format. The API rejects generic octet-stream types and content that doesn't match the block type. * The API concatenates adjacent text blocks in `input` and `instructions` in order with no separator. Include your own spaces or newlines (`\n`) between blocks. * Input can't be empty. ### Structured data {% id="structured-data" %} Serialize JSON objects and arrays to a string and pass them as text so keys inside your payload stay plain data rather than content blocks. In your question instructions, refer to JSON fields by their key path: ```python state = json.dumps({"customer": {"tier": "Gold"}, "order": {"id": "8821", "age_days": 14}}) ``` ### Documents (PDF) {% id="documents" %} Pass a PDF up to 50 MB as inline base64 bytes. For larger or reusable files, upload them with the [Files API](/docs/files). The model reads text, tables, charts, and page layouts together. This example checks an invoice PDF for a purchase order number and routes it to an expense category: {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python import base64 from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) with open("invoice.pdf", "rb") as f: pdf_b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8") result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input=[ { "type": "document", "data": pdf_b64, "mime_type": "application/pdf", }, ], questions={ "has_po_number": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Does the invoice include a purchase order (PO) number?", }, "expense_category": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "Which expense category fits this invoice?", "criteria": { "cloud_infrastructure": "Servers, GPU compute, hosting, or storage.", "software_licenses": "SaaS subscriptions or seat licenses.", "travel": "Flights, hotels, meals, or ground transport.", "other": "Anything outside these categories.", }, }, }, ) po = result.answers["has_po_number"] category = result.answers["expense_category"] print(po.noul, category.choice, category.confidence) ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"; import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const pdfB64 = readFileSync("invoice.pdf").toString("base64"); const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: [ { type: "document", data: pdfB64, mime_type: "application/pdf", }, ], questions: { has_po_number: { type: "noul", instructions: "Does the invoice include a purchase order (PO) number?", }, expense_category: { type: "choice", instructions: "Which expense category fits this invoice?", criteria: { cloud_infrastructure: "Servers, GPU compute, hosting, or storage.", software_licenses: "SaaS subscriptions or seat licenses.", travel: "Flights, hotels, meals, or ground transport.", other: "Anything outside these categories.", }, }, }, }); const po = result.answers?.has_po_number; const category = result.answers?.expense_category; if (po?.type === "noul" && category?.type === "choice") { console.log(po.noul, category.choice, category.confidence); } ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": [ { "type": "document", "data": "<BASE64_PDF_DATA>", "mime_type": "application/pdf" } ], "questions": { "has_po_number": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Does the invoice include a purchase order (PO) number?" }, "expense_category": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "Which expense category fits this invoice?", "criteria": { "cloud_infrastructure": "Servers, GPU compute, hosting, or storage.", "software_licenses": "SaaS subscriptions or seat licenses.", "travel": "Flights, hotels, meals, or ground transport.", "other": "Anything outside these categories." } } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} ### Images {% id="media" %} Pass local image bytes as base64 or pass a URI, and set resolution to trade visual detail against token cost. This example checks a product photo for damage: {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python import base64 from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) with open("earcup.jpg", "rb") as f: image_b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8") result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input=[ {"type": "text", "text": "Customer photo for return request #8821."}, { "type": "image", "data": image_b64, "mime_type": "image/jpeg", "resolution": "low", # Supported values: "low", "medium", "high", "ultra_high" }, ], questions={ "visible_damage": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Does the photo show physical damage to the device? Ignore the packaging.", }, }, ) print(result.answers["visible_damage"].noul) ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"; import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const imageB64 = readFileSync("earcup.jpg").toString("base64"); const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: [ { type: "text", text: "Customer photo for return request #8821." }, { type: "image", data: imageB64, mime_type: "image/jpeg", resolution: "low", // Supported values: "low", "medium", "high", "ultra_high" }, ], questions: { visible_damage: { type: "noul", instructions: "Does the photo show physical damage to the device? Ignore the packaging.", }, }, }); const answer = result.answers?.visible_damage; if (answer?.type === "noul") console.log(answer.noul); ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": [ { "type": "text", "text": "Customer photo for return request #8821." }, { "type": "image", "data": "<BASE64_IMAGE_DATA>", "mime_type": "image/jpeg", "resolution": "low" } ], "questions": { "visible_damage": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Does the photo show physical damage to the device? Ignore the packaging." } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} ### Audio {% id="audio" %} Pass a public or signed HTTPS URL, upload local recordings with the [Files API](/docs/files), or send inline base64 bytes. The model evaluates spoken words, pacing, and vocal tone without a separate transcription step, making it suitable for call triage, QA, and speech evaluation. This example checks a speech recording for its topic and scores the speaker's delivery: {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input=[ { "type": "audio", "uri": "https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/audio/rehearsing.wav", "mime_type": "audio/wav", }, ], questions={ "mentions_launch": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Is the speaker talking about a product campaign launch?", }, "delivery": { "type": "score", "instructions": "How fluent and prepared does the speaker sound?", "criteria": [ "Hesitant, searching for notes, or self-correcting.", "Mostly steady with minor pauses.", "Polished, fluent, and confident throughout.", ], }, }, ) print(result.answers["mentions_launch"].noul, result.answers["delivery"].score) ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: [ { type: "audio", uri: "https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/audio/rehearsing.wav", mime_type: "audio/wav", }, ], questions: { mentions_launch: { type: "noul", instructions: "Is the speaker talking about a product campaign launch?", }, delivery: { type: "score", instructions: "How fluent and prepared does the speaker sound?", criteria: [ "Hesitant, searching for notes, or self-correcting.", "Mostly steady with minor pauses.", "Polished, fluent, and confident throughout.", ], }, }, }); const launch = result.answers?.mentions_launch; const delivery = result.answers?.delivery; if (launch?.type === "noul" && delivery?.type === "score") { console.log(launch.noul, delivery.score); } ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": [ { "type": "audio", "uri": "https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/audio/rehearsing.wav", "mime_type": "audio/wav" } ], "questions": { "mentions_launch": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Is the speaker talking about a product campaign launch?" }, "delivery": { "type": "score", "instructions": "How fluent and prepared does the speaker sound?", "criteria": [ "Hesitant, searching for notes, or self-correcting.", "Mostly steady with minor pauses.", "Polished, fluent, and confident throughout." ] } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} For local files or recordings larger than 15 MB, upload once with the [Files API](/docs/files) and pass the returned URI (the same pattern works for PDFs, images, and video): ```python uploaded = client.files.upload(file="support_call.wav") audio_block = {"type": "audio", "uri": uploaded.uri, "mime_type": uploaded.mime_type} ``` ### Video {% id="video" %} Pass video through the [Files API](/docs/files), a public or signed HTTPS URL, or inline base64 bytes.
